basic_profile.bio: Avid tabletop RPG enthusiast and hobbyist game master hailing from Portland, Oregon. I got into role-playing games in college and have been hooked ever since. Outside of gaming, I'm a mechanical engineer with a penchant for DIY projects and motorcycle customization. I love sharing crafting tips and tricks with fellow RPG fans. I'm typically online in the evenings after work and on weekends. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in mechanical engineering, which I apply to both my professional life and my RPG hobby. My knowledge of Pathfinder and other RPG systems comes from years of playing, reading rulebooks, and engaging with the community. I frequently attend conventions and workshops to stay updated.
